Pixel-art sprite sheets, smooth smoke and fire, and steadier Pyro.

**Pixel-art sprite sheets**
- Tick **Pixel art** in Export Sprite Sheet (or pass `--pixel-art 4`). Each block of rendered pixels becomes one pixel, every pixel solid or clear, in one palette shared by every frame, so nothing flickers as it plays. Small sparks still show up as single pixels.
- Pick the colours from the effect itself (16 by default), or use your game's own palette: a Lospec `.hex`, a GIMP or Aseprite `.gpl`, or an image of swatches. Optional **Dither** turns gradients and fading smoke into patterns of pixels, and **Outline** adds a one-pixel dark outline.
- **Bevy:** bevy_procedural_fx 0.3.1 loads pixel-art sheets unfiltered, so they stay sharp however far you scale them. **Godot:** the flipbook scene is set to Nearest; set an AnimatedSprite2D's texture filter to Nearest. **Unity:** the sheet imports with Point filtering.

**Smooth smoke and fire**
- Smoke and fire (Pyro, and fog VDBs) are drawn as continuous volumes in the viewport, instead of many soft dots: smooth at any distance, and a little faster. Sprite sheets and real-time renders use the same drawing, so exported smoke and fire look smoother too.

**Steadier Pyro**
- Turbulence used to push small plumes off to one side, as if there were wind. It now stirs them in place, so they rise straight and still curl and spread. **Fire** and **Toon fire** now burn upright, so their exported sheets look a little different.
- The **Smoke** preset is now a real Pyro simulation, looped like Fire: a soft wisp that rises, curls and fades.

**Crash reports, only if you choose**
- After the app closes unexpectedly, the recovery prompt can send the crash report to us, so we can fix what went wrong. Nothing is sent unless you click **Send the report**. You can see exactly what would be sent first, with your home folder shown as ~, and add a note. See the [privacy policy](https://www.build3dstudio.com/privacy).

**Fixes**
- A long status message no longer runs over the timeline's play buttons. It's cut short, and the whole message shows when you hover over it.
- The hint after opening a preset no longer disappears when its first frame finishes cooking.
- Random seeds larger than about 4 billion turned into 0 when a scene was saved and opened again. They now stay at the largest seed.

**Tutorials**
- The [game export tutorial](https://www.build3dstudio.com/tutorial-game-export) covers pixel art.
